otherText: Page title: 'PRECIO MENÚ:' in a black Japanese-style display font, with a red brush stroke underneath
Group heading above MEDIODÍA and NOCHE (applies to both): 'Lunes a Viernes, no festivos'. A thin red vertical rule separates the MEDIODÍA and NOCHE columns
The NOCHE sub-label '*Viernes noche no incluído' is tiny italic text directly under 'NOCHE' (the accent is on the í of 'incluído')
In 'VIERNES NOCHE / FINES DE SEMANA / FESTIVO' the slashes are red and the words are black. In 'Gratis / Free' the words are red and the slash is black
Prices and hours are set in red bold italic. Labels are black
Address line has a black map-pin icon, email line has a black envelope icon. The address is printed in lowercase and without accents: 'd'isabel la catolica'
Slogan is in red script on two lines: 'La infinidad de Japón' then 'a un precio cerrado', with a red brush line to the left of the second line

Allergen legend layout: 2 rows of 7. Row 1: CONTIENE GLUTEN, CRUSTÁCEOS, HUEVOS, PESCADO, CACAHUETES, SOJA, LÁCTEOS. Row 2: FRUTOS DE CÁSCARA, APIO, MOSTAZA, GRANOS DE SÉSAMO, DIÓXIDO DE AZUFRE Y SULFITOS, ALTRAMUCES, MOLUSCOS. Every glyph is white on a filled circle. Labels print on two lines as 'CONTIENE / GLUTEN', 'FRUTOS / DE CÁSCARA', 'GRANOS / DE SÉSAMO' and 'DIÓXIDO DE AZUFRE / Y SULFITOS'

Icon pairs that are easy to confuse: CRUSTÁCEOS (bright blue #00a0dc, crab) vs MOLUSCOS (turquoise #4dc3d0, scallop shell). SOJA (medium green #0fa559, leaves and pod) vs APIO (light lime #6fbf4a, celery). LÁCTEOS (dark brown #6a402d, jug) vs CACAHUETES (tan #ae7b56, peanuts). MOSTAZA (ochre #b49546, bottle and squiggle) vs ALTRAMUCES (yellow #e9ce5f, three round beans). CONTIENE GLUTEN (terracotta #d57849, wheat) vs HUEVOS (orange #ee943f, eggs). PESCADO is the only dark navy one. DIÓXIDO DE AZUFRE Y SULFITOS is the only purple one, with 'E-X' text
The fish note sits to the right of the legend in black caps
Background is a pale red seigaiha wave pattern on white, with a solid red band along the bottom edge of the page
